nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and ready to move on a refi — the play is to remove friction and advance directly to application, not re-sell or interrogate them with discovery questions.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly to what they asked — no generic opener, no re-pitch
  - Acknowledge their current situation: 6.88% conventional, $1,971/mo P&I on ~$299K remaining balance
  - Answer their specific question first, then bridge to next step

- Move straight to the soft credit pull / application — do not layer in discovery questions
  - Say something like: 'I can pull up today's rates against your 6.88% right now with no impact to your credit — takes about 2 minutes. Want me to send the link?'
  - Have the e-sign / soft pull link ready to drop in the same message or the very next one

- Keep the message short and action-forward
  - One clear ask: click the link or confirm a 10-minute call
  - Do not ask multiple questions or introduce new topics — one next step only

- Once they engage, present the real numbers
  - Run actual current market rate against their 6.88% and show the monthly delta vs. $1,971
  - Compute break-even on closing costs using their actual quote — do not estimate or invent a savings figure before you have a real rate locked in
